text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED: sso-proxy heartbeat spike -> surge of 401s + stack-trace logging to internal ELK. paging oncall. link: https://pager.example/INC-19384
alex_cheng: On it, looking at the proxy logs now. seeing a lot of 401 + intermittent 500s.
maria_gomez: Can you paste a sample log line? any PII/tokens in stack?
alex_cheng: here's a truncated snippet, removing long hashes but you can see header leak in stacktrace:
```
ERROR sso-proxy - panic: runtime error
  at auth/verify.go:42
  request_headers: {
    "Host": "sso.prod.redwood.ai",
    "Authorization": "Bearer eyJhbGciOi...REDACTED...",
    "User-Agent": "curl/7.68.0"
  }
stack: auth.Verify -> http.Handle -> runtime.go
```
alex_cheng: it looks like a debug/stacktrace flag is dumping headers into the log. this could have exposed auth bearer fragments to internal logging pipelines.
security_team: tagging in. critical question: any evidence of logs leaving internal cluster (egress to 3rd-party) or public S3 bucket?
tim_lee: Checking ELK forwarding and s3 sinks. quick grep shows recent forwarding to analytics-raw-bucket with put events since 10m. listing put events now.
jordan_s: If the bucket is public or used for external analytics, assume potential exposure and rotate keys asap.
maria_gomez: @tim_lee please confirm bucket ACL and object timestamps. if public, start rotation immediately.
tim_lee: analytics-raw-bucket ACL = private, but lifecycle pipeline pushes to external partner S3 for advanced analytics; that transfer job ran at 1938456500. need to check that partner's bucket ACL.
ops_bot: runbook step 1: isolate sso-proxy, step 2: rotate service tokens, step 3: disable stacktrace debug.
alex_cheng: quick mitigation path: 1) flip sso-proxy debug off (env var DEBUG_STACK=false) 2) throttle/blackhole transfer job 3) create new svc account key + deploy 4) revoke old key via KMS 5) notify customers.
maria_gomez: I'll take key rotation. @security_team take lead on exposure assessment with partner. @customer_success prepare customer comms template.
security_team: I'm seeing 4 transfer destinations; contacting partner ops now. they acknowledged and are checking ACLs.
marcus (customer_success): drafting short-safe-notice: "We detected anomalous auth header data in internal logs; we are rotating service credentials and will follow up if you were affected". need ETA on rotation.
alex_cheng: rotation ETA ~ 12min for staged rollout. commands: 
```bash
# create new SA key
redwoodctl iam svc-keys create sso-proxy-rotate-193845 -o json > newkey.json
# apply to secret manager
redwoodctl secrets put sso-proxy/sa-key --from-file=newkey.json
# rolling restart deployment
kubectl rollout restart deployment/sso-proxy -n prod
```
alex_cheng: starting now. patching deployment env var to disable debug first.
ops_bot: Action logged: DEBUG_STACK set to false at 1938456882 by alex_cheng.
tim_lee: pausing transfer pipeline: `airflow pause dag analytics_transfer` at 1938456920. confirmed paused.
maria_gomez: new key created and secret updated. initiating rollout.
jordan_s: once the rollout finishes, re-query ELK to ensure new logs don't contain header dumps. also run grep for 'Authorization: Bearer' across recent indices.
alex_cheng: rollout progressing: pod sso-proxy-1 -> Ready, sso-proxy-2 -> Ready, sso-proxy-3 -> Restarting...
ops_bot: rollout complete at 1938457075.
alex_cheng: quick grep: found 37 log entries with header fragments between 1938456400 and 1938456600. forwarding to security for assessment.
security_team: partner confirmed destination bucket ACL is private and ingestion job writes to partner-internal-only. they will run log retention purge for objects created in that window. asking for list of object keys.
tim_lee: providing object keys and transfer job trace now.
security_team: still treat as potential exposure until partner confirms purge complete. proceeding to revoke old key.
maria_gomez: revoking old key via KMS: `redwoodctl iam svc-keys revoke sso-proxy-old-1938` executed at 1938457201.
ops_bot: Key rotation complete. New key active. Old key revoked.
alex_cheng: validating traffic: 401 spike has subsided, 5xxs back to normal. latency nominal.
jordan_s: scanning ELK for header dumps post-mitigation -> no new hits after 1938457075.
security_team: partner confirms purge complete and provided signed attestation at 1938457500. no external public ACL seen.
marcus (customer_success): drafting customer message: short, non-alarming, next steps. waiting for final sign-off.
customer_success: message ready. advise sending targeted notices to affected customers (3 customers with sessions during window).
alex_cheng: root cause hypothesis: debug flag enabled accidentally in 1 canary release of sso-proxy config, combined with a downstream transfer job that pushed recent raw logs to partner. fix: add logging guard to avoid printing auth headers, require masking in log pipeline, add egress check for transfer job to confirm destination ACL.
security_team: recommend two follow-ups: 1) post-incident audit of logging pipeline and alert if headers appear, 2) policy to prevent header material in logs + CI check.
maria_gomez: will lead follow-up. timeline: audit + CI guard in 48h, add egress verification to transfer job in 72h.
alex_cheng: system stabilized. handing off to security and CS for remediation & customer comms.
security_team: taking incident ownership for 24h watch, will update #incidents with final report.
marcus (customer_success): will send the initial customer notice in 30m and collect replies.
alex_cheng: Thanks all. logging timeline and artifacts in the incident document: https://go.incidents/1938456789. leaving channel. :white_check_mark:
security_team: Handoff note: monitoring set, detection rule added for 'Authorization: Bearer' raw string, retention purge verified. Next update EOD.
